mcq.q: How is a kayamba played?
options: By rubbing a bow across it
mcq.explanation: The kayamba is a shaker with seeds inside. You shake it back and forth.

mcq.q: What does the drumhead do when it is struck?
options: It vibrates and makes the sound
mcq.explanation: The stretched skin shakes very fast and produces sound.

mcq.q: Which is the beater of a drum?
options: The stick or hand that strikes it
mcq.explanation: The beater is what hits the drumhead.

mcq.q: On a xylophone, the long bars give
mcq.explanation: Longer bars vibrate more slowly and sound lower.

mcq.q: When accompanying singers, the drummers should
options: play softly enough for the singers to be heard
mcq.explanation: Accompaniment supports the singers and must not cover their voices.

mcq.q: Which twigs are best for making charcoal sticks?
options: Dry, straight twigs about as thick as a pencil
mcq.explanation: Dry, straight, thin twigs burn evenly into good drawing sticks.

mcq.q: To make a very dark tone with charcoal you should
mcq.explanation: Pressing harder leaves more charcoal, so the tone is darker.

mcq.q: In netball, the ball is moved mainly by
mcq.explanation: Players may not run with the ball, so they pass it to move it forward.

mcq.q: Where must a player stand to shoot at goal?
mcq.explanation: Shots must be taken from inside the goal circle.

mcq.q: Which attacker may NOT enter the goal circle?
mcq.explanation: The Wing Attack plays in the centre and goal thirds but not in the circle.

mcq.q: Which is a rule break in netball?
mcq.explanation: Contact such as pushing is not allowed.

mcq.q: In a double-handed catch, where should your eyes be?
options: On the ball until it is in your hands
mcq.explanation: Watching the ball helps you catch it.

mcq.q: What should you do after passing the ball?
options: Move into space to receive it again
mcq.explanation: Moving into open space keeps the game flowing.

mcq.q: What is the main reason for improvising a netball?
options: To use available materials when balls are not enough
Because real balls are always bad
mcq.explanation: Improvising lets us practise with materials we already have.

mcq.q: Which colours are the primary colours?
mcq.explanation: Primary colours cannot be made by mixing other colours.

mcq.q: How many secondary colours are there on the basic colour wheel?
mcq.explanation: Orange, green and purple are the three secondary colours.

mcq.q: What do you add to a colour to make it lighter?
options: More of the same colour only
mcq.explanation: White makes a tint, a lighter tone.

mcq.q: A value scale strip shows
options: steps from light to dark of one colour
mcq.explanation: A scale strip shows one colour changing from light to dark.

mcq.q: What is a palette?
mcq.explanation: A palette is where paints are mixed.

mcq.q: What is the theme of the montage in this lesson?
mcq.explanation: The montage is themed ball games.

mcq.q: How is flour paste made?
options: Mix flour and cold water to a smooth paste, then add hot water while stirring
mcq.explanation: An adult adds hot water to thicken the smooth paste.

mcq.q: Which of these is a dark tone of red?
options: Red mixed with a little black
mcq.explanation: Adding black makes a darker shade of red.

mcq.q: The French rhythm name for a crotchet is
mcq.explanation: Taa is the name for one long sound in one beat.

mcq.q: What does a crotchet look like?
options: A filled-in oval with a stem
mcq.explanation: A crotchet has a filled note head and a stem.

mcq.q: Which statement is true?
options: A crotchet is shorter than a quaver
A rest is longer than a note

mcq.q: Free hand lettering means writing letters
options: by hand without a ruler or stencil
mcq.explanation: Free hand means using only your hand.

mcq.q: Which of these letters has neither an ascender nor a descender?
mcq.explanation: The letter a sits between the baseline and the top of small letters.

mcq.q: Repeating a small group of notes in a rhythm helps listeners to
mcq.explanation: Repetition gives shape and makes the rhythm easier to remember.

mcq.q: Why should your composed rhythm be your own idea?
options: To be different from the teacher only
mcq.explanation: Creating your own pattern shows integrity.

mcq.q: The sol-fa syllable d is pronounced
mcq.explanation: The syllable d is doh.

mcq.q: The middle note of d, r and m is
mcq.explanation: Ray lies between doh and me.

mcq.q: Hand signs for d, r and m are shown at heights that
options: go down from d to m
go up from d to r to m
mcq.explanation: The signs rise as the pitch rises.

mcq.q: Stepwise motion means the tune moves
options: to the next note above or below
mcq.explanation: Steps go to a neighbouring note.

mcq.q: Which tune ends on the home note?
mcq.explanation: Only d r m r d ends on d.

mcq.q: What is clay?
options: Fine sticky soil that is soft when wet and hard when dry
mcq.explanation: Clay is a fine, sticky soil used for modelling.

mcq.q: How can you make a slab of even thickness?
options: Roll the clay with a bottle between two sticks of equal thickness
mcq.explanation: Equal sticks on both sides keep the slab even.

mcq.q: Which is a sprint distance in big athletics competitions?
mcq.explanation: The sprints are 100 m, 200 m and 400 m.

mcq.q: Which describes a false start in a sprint?
mcq.explanation: A false start is leaving before the start signal.

mcq.q: How far apart are the hands placed at the start?
options: One on each side of the track
mcq.explanation: Hands are about shoulder-width apart.

mcq.q: Why should the knees lift high when sprinting?
options: To give a stronger, longer stride
mcq.explanation: High knees produce a powerful stride.

mcq.q: A relay race is a race in which
options: team members take turns running and pass a baton
one person runs all the way
mcq.explanation: In a relay, runners pass a baton to the next teammate.

mcq.q: On the Kenyan flag, black stands for
mcq.explanation: Black represents the people of Kenya.

mcq.q: Which is a good ratio of length to height for a flag drawing?
mcq.explanation: A flag rectangle is about one and a half times as long as it is high.

mcq.q: Which is a safety rule for sprint races?
options: Never push or trip another runner
mcq.explanation: Pushing or tripping can hurt people.

mcq.q: In a crab balance, your body should look like
mcq.explanation: Arms and legs are the table legs, and the body is the top.

mcq.q: Which muscles does the crab balance mainly strengthen?
mcq.explanation: Holding the body up uses many muscle groups.

mcq.q: Why do we stand up slowly after a side roll?
mcq.explanation: Getting up too fast can make you dizzy.

mcq.q: What should you do if something hurts during gymnastics?
mcq.explanation: Pain is a warning, so stop and tell the teacher.

mcq.q: What is the last part of the sequence in this lesson?
options: Getting up slowly and standing tall
mcq.explanation: Finish by standing up slowly with control.

mcq.q: Which is the correct first step in the crab balance?
options: Sit with knees bent and feet flat
mcq.explanation: You start sitting with knees bent and feet flat.

mcq.q: Which quality do rolls and balances build?
mcq.explanation: Gymnastics teaches the body to stay steady and move parts together.

mcq.q: A topical song is
options: about a topic that matters at a certain time
mcq.explanation: Topical songs give messages about topics such as health, safety or the environment.

mcq.q: Tempo means
mcq.explanation: Tempo is how fast or slow.

mcq.q: A sign that narrows to the right means
mcq.explanation: A closing sign means the music grows softer.

mcq.q: When singing, you should breathe
options: deeply so your tummy moves out gently
mcq.explanation: Deep breathing supports the voice.

mcq.q: Singing in unison means
options: everyone sings the same notes at the same time
mcq.explanation: Unison means the same notes together.

mcq.q: Which folk songs are sung while working?
mcq.explanation: Work songs give rhythm to work.

mcq.q: Call and response in a folk song means
options: a soloist leads and the group answers
mcq.explanation: The soloist calls and the chorus answers.

mcq.q: Which is a digital device for photography?
mcq.explanation: A smartphone has a camera lens and digital memory.

mcq.q: The battery of a camera
mcq.explanation: Without power the device will not work.

mcq.q: Why use a camera strap?
options: So the camera does not drop
mcq.explanation: A strap protects the device from falls.

mcq.q: The word photography comes from words meaning
mcq.explanation: Photography means drawing with light.

mcq.q: What is the danger of pointing a camera directly at the sun?
options: It can hurt your eyes and spoil the picture
mcq.explanation: Looking at the sun harms the eyes.

mcq.q: What should you do about distracting things behind the subject?
options: Remove them or change the angle
mcq.explanation: A plain background keeps attention on the subject.

mcq.q: Which photo should be kept?
options: One that is dark and blurred
One with a finger on the lens
One with good light and a clear centre of interest
mcq.explanation: Good photographs are well lit and clear.

mcq.q: The descant recorder is played by
mcq.explanation: A recorder is a wind instrument that you blow.

mcq.q: The bottom part of the recorder is the
mcq.explanation: The foot joint ends in the bell.

mcq.q: Covering more finger holes makes the note
mcq.explanation: More holes covered gives a longer air column, so a lower note.

mcq.q: What sound do you hear if a hole is not fully covered?
mcq.explanation: Leaks make squeaks.

mcq.q: What should you do before playing to prevent spreading germs?
mcq.explanation: Clean hands help hygiene.

mcq.q: Which note is played with the thumb hole and hole 1 covered?
mcq.explanation: B uses the thumb and the first hole.

mcq.q: Music is written on a
mcq.explanation: The staff has five lines and four spaces.

mcq.q: If G is doh, then B is
mcq.explanation: G, A, B match d, r, m.

mcq.q: Where should you walk beside the pool?
options: On the pool side, walking slowly
mcq.explanation: Wet floors are slippery.

mcq.q: If you are in trouble in the water, you should
options: raise your arm and shout for help
mcq.explanation: Signal for help.

mcq.q: After entering, you should
options: move away from the edge so the next person can enter
mcq.explanation: Make space for others.

mcq.q: Which is a rule for water games?
options: Do not hold anyone under water
mcq.explanation: Safety first.

mcq.q: Supine means
mcq.explanation: Supine is lying on the back.

mcq.q: In a glide, your arms are
options: stretched above the head with palms together
mcq.explanation: Arms overhead create a streamlined shape.

mcq.q: Which is part of pool hygiene?
options: Not passing urine or spitting in the pool
mcq.explanation: Keeping the pool clean matters.

mcq.q: Animal games are inspired by
options: the movements and behaviour of animals
mcq.explanation: Children copy how animals move.

mcq.q: The elephant walk is done by
options: bending forward and letting your arms hang like a trunk
mcq.explanation: Slow heavy steps with arms as a trunk.

mcq.q: In the giraffe stretch, you
options: stand tall on toes with arms high
mcq.explanation: Reach up like a giraffe.

mcq.q: Which Kiswahili word means elephant?
mcq.explanation: Tembo is an elephant.

mcq.q: What happens when the hawk tags the last chick?
mcq.explanation: Roles change so everyone plays.

mcq.q: Before animal games you should
mcq.explanation: Warming up prepares muscles.

mcq.q: Why are indigenous games part of our heritage?
options: They come to us from earlier generations
mcq.explanation: Heritage is what we inherit.

mcq.q: The message of an art work is
options: what the artist wants us to learn or feel
mcq.explanation: The message is the idea communicated.

mcq.q: A portfolio is
options: a folder for keeping creative works together
mcq.explanation: It protects and presents works.

mcq.q: How can you decorate a portfolio cover?
options: By pasting coloured paper or fabric
mcq.explanation: Decorating uses local resources.

mcq.q: Works on display should be kept away from
mcq.explanation: Water, sun and dust can damage works.

mcq.q: When the anthem is sung, you should
mcq.explanation: Show respect.

mcq.q: Verse 1 of the anthem asks
mcq.explanation: The first verse is a prayer for blessing.

mcq.q: Which words describe how loud or soft a performance was?
mcq.explanation: Dynamics are loud and soft.

short.q: Explain the job of the drumhead and the shell of a drum.
short.answer: The drumhead vibrates when struck and makes the sound. The hollow shell makes the sound fuller and louder.
short.working: 1 mark for the drumhead, 2 marks for the shell's job explained.

short.q: What does it mean to improvise a rhythmic pattern?
short.answer: To make up a pattern on the spot without writing it first, using an instrument such as a drum or shaker to keep to the beat of a song.
short.working: 1 mark for making up on the spot, 1 mark for no writing first, 1 mark for using an instrument.

short.q: Describe how to draw a drum with tonal value using the smudge technique.
short.answer: Draw the outline lightly. Shade the dark parts by pressing harder and the light parts by pressing lightly. Rub the shading with a finger or tissue to blend. Leave the brightest part white.

short.q: Describe the position of the back knee in the medium start and in the elongated start.
short.answer: In the medium start, the back knee is level with the middle of the front foot. In the elongated start it is level with the heel of the front foot.
short.working: 1 mark for each position, 1 mark for saying the elongated start is further back.

short.q: Give four safety rules for sprint races.
short.answer: Run in your own lane; check the track for stones; wear proper clothes; never push or trip; slow down gradually after the finish; warm up. Any four.

short.q: Give three reasons for flying the Kenyan flag at an athletics event.
short.answer: It shows which country the athletes represent; it builds pride and patriotism; it brings people together to cheer; it shows respect to visitors. Any three.

short.q: Explain why only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack can score goals.
short.answer: Netball rules say only these two attackers may shoot, and only from inside the goal circle. Other players help by passing the ball to them.
short.working: 1 mark for the two players, 1 mark for the goal circle, 1 mark for the role of the others.

short.q: When is an overhead pass better than a chest pass?
short.answer: When a defender stands close so that the ball must go over their arms.
short.working: 1 mark for a defender, 1 mark for going over.

short.q: Explain how to tie an overhand knot.
short.answer: Make a loop with the cord. Pass the end through the loop. Pull both ends to tighten.

short.q: Name the three secondary colours and state how each is made.
short.answer: Orange from red and yellow, green from yellow and blue, purple from blue and red.
short.working: 1 mark for each secondary colour with its mixture.

short.q: Describe how to paint a fruit so that it looks round using colour value.
short.answer: Draw the outline. Paint the main colour. Add a lighter tone on the side facing the light and a darker tone on the side away from the light. Blend the edges and add a shadow.

short.q: Describe how to make flour paste glue.
short.answer: Mix flour with a little cold water to a smooth paste. An adult adds hot water while stirring. Let it cool before use.

short.q: State the length of a crotchet and of a quaver in beats.
short.answer: A crotchet is one beat and a quaver is half a beat.

short.q: How many beats are there in the pattern ta-te ta-te taa taa? Show your working.
short.answer: 4 beats. Ta-te is 1 beat, ta-te is 1 beat, taa is 1 beat and taa is 1 beat, so 1+1+1+1 = 4.

short.q: Explain how to write a rhythm from dictation.
short.answer: Listen twice to the pattern. Count the beats. For each beat decide if it was one long sound, two short sounds or silence, and write taa, ta-te or a rest.

short.q: Why do singers use hand signs?
short.answer: To show and remember the height of each note, and to help them sing in tune.
short.working: 1 mark for showing pitch, 1 mark for remembering or singing in tune.

short.q: Explain how to compose a short melody using d, r and m.
short.answer: Choose a rhythm. Give a syllable to each note. Use steps. End on d as a crotchet. Sing it and show the hand signs. Write the syllables under the rhythm names.

short.q: How should clay models be dried and why?
short.answer: Slowly in the shade. Strong sun dries them too fast and makes them crack.

short.q: Give three common mistakes in the crab balance and how to fix them.
short.answer: Hips sagging: push harder. Bent arms: straighten them. Head dropped: keep it in line.
short.working: 1 mark for each mistake with a fix.

short.q: What is a sequence in gymnastics? Give an example.
short.answer: A set of movements done in a fixed order. For example crab balance, lower to the mat, lie straight, side roll.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for the correct example.

short.q: Name two types of songs learnt in this topic other than folk songs.
short.answer: Sacred songs, patriotic songs and topical songs. Any two.

short.q: Explain the meaning of diction and why it matters.
short.answer: Diction is saying the words clearly. It matters because the audience can understand the message of the song.
short.working: 1 mark for meaning, 2 marks for the reason.

short.q: Name three types of Kenyan folk songs and say when each is sung.
short.answer: Work songs during work, funeral songs when someone dies, naming songs when a baby is named, initiation songs at initiation, marriage songs at weddings, worship songs at worship. Any three.
short.working: 1 mark for each type with its occasion.

short.q: Name two digital devices used for taking photographs.
short.answer: Smartphone, tablet, digital camera. Any two.

short.q: Explain where the sun should be when you photograph a person and why.
short.answer: Behind the photographer, so light falls on the front of the person. If the sun is behind the subject, the face is in shadow.
short.working: 1 mark for the position, 2 marks for the reason.

short.q: How do you select the best photographs?
short.answer: Check for good light, a clear subject, sharpness and no distractions, and delete the poor ones.

short.q: Explain why covering more holes makes a lower note.
short.answer: The column of air inside becomes longer, and a longer air column vibrates more slowly, giving a lower note.
short.working: 1 mark for longer air column, 2 marks for lower note.

short.q: Describe how to blow to make a good tone.
short.answer: Put the mouthpiece between the lips, take a deep breath, blow gently and steadily, and start each note with a soft too or doo.

short.q: State three points to check when giving feedback to a friend playing the recorder.
short.answer: Correct notes, steady rhythm and rests, clear tone without squeaks, good posture. Any three.

short.q: Name three water games and say how one is played.
short.answer: Bubble blowing, treasure hunt, follow the leader, water tag, circle walk. One correct explanation.
short.working: 1 mark each for three games, or 1 mark each for two games and an explanation.

short.q: State three mistakes in gliding and how to correct them.
short.answer: Lifting the head: keep it between the arms; bent arms or legs: stretch them; pushing too hard: push gently. Any three.

short.q: Explain why animal games are called indigenous activities.
short.answer: They come from the communities and their environment, need little or no equipment and are learnt by watching and joining in.

short.q: Describe the game hawk and the chicks.
short.answer: A hen stands in front and chicks hold on behind in a line. A hawk tries to tag the last chick. The hen spreads her arms and blocks. When the last chick is tagged, roles change.

short.q: Write rhythm patterns for the elephant walk and the hare hop using rhythm names.
short.answer: Elephant walk: taa taa taa (rest). Hare hop: ta-te ta-te ta-te ta-te.
short.working: 1 mark for each pattern, 1 mark for correct rest or names.

short.q: Explain what is meant by two stars and a wish in feedback.
short.answer: Say two good things about the work and then give one suggestion for improvement.

short.q: Give four ways of caring for displayed works.
short.answer: Do not touch or write on them; keep away from water, sun and dust; keep neat labels; store in the portfolio flat afterwards. Any four.

short.q: How should you behave when the Kenya National Anthem is sung?
short.answer: Stand straight and still, face the flag, remove your cap, sing clearly and do not talk or play.

short.q: Why is it important to appreciate the works of people from different cultures?
short.answer: We learn about others, it builds respect and unity and it helps us value all cultures.

short.q: Describe how to compose a short melody with d, r and m, and how to check that it is a good melody.
short.answer: Choose a rhythm. Give each note a syllable, using steps. End on d. Sing it with hand signs. Check that it has variation and stepwise motion and that it ends on d.
short.working: 1 mark for each of five valid points.

short.q: Describe how to play an animal game safely and fairly from warm-up to the end.
short.answer: Warm up and choose soft clear ground. Explain the rules and roles. Play the game without pushing or pulling. Stop at the whistle and give everyone a turn. Cool down and drink water.
